blurb: Guests can rent jet skis, power boats, kayaks, paddle boards, and electric boats to explore San Diego Bay. Rentals include options for single or tandem kayaks and stand up paddle boards with tips and easy launch points. The business is located inside the Sheraton San Diego Hotel & Marina and offers a comprehensive experience including resort amenities.
